instances.description: List of btfs mount instances; each must include metadata and mountpoint keys. metadata is a torrent file path or magnet URI; mountpoint is the target directory. One instance per line in output config file (as per SYNOPSIS).

instances[].description: A single btfs mount instance (used only as schema for list items).

instances[].metadata.description: Path to .torrent file or magnet URI (e.g., 'magnet:?xt=urn:btih:...'). Must be non-empty.

instances[].mountpoint.description: Mount point directory for this instance. Must be non-empty.

global_options.description: Optional global btfs options (applied to all instances). All keys are optional.

global_options.browse_only.description: If true, pass --browse-only to download metadata only.

global_options.keep.description: If true, pass --keep to retain files after unmount.

global_options.utp_only.description: If true, pass --utp-only to disable TCP and use uTP only.

global_options.data_directory.description: Override default data directory (e.g., '/var/lib/btfs'). Corresponds to --data-directory.

global_options.min_port.description: Start of listen port range for peer connections. Corresponds to --min-port.

global_options.max_port.description: End of listen port range for peer connections. Corresponds to --max-port.

global_options.max_download_rate.description: Maximum download rate in kilobytes per second. Corresponds to --max-download-rate.

global_options.max_upload_rate.description: Maximum upload rate in kilobytes per second. Corresponds to --max-upload-rate.
